MECHAI AUTOMOTIVE SERVICE MANUAL
Section 11: Engine Cooling System
General Description and Operating Principles:
The cooling system maintains engine operating temperature within the optimal range of 88C to 95C. A wax-pellet thermostat
regulates coolant flow through the radiator.
WARNING: Never open radiator cap when engine is hot.
Thermostat Housing Bolt Torque: 12 Nm (106 in-lb).

Thermostat Replacement Procedure
1. Disconnect negative battery cable.
2. Drain engine coolant into a clean container.
3. Disconnect radiator upper hose from water outlet.
4. Remove water outlet fitting bolts and remove thermostat.
5. Install new thermostat with jiggle valve facing upward.
6. Tighten mounting bolts to specified torque (12 Nm).
Figure 11-1: Thermostat Assembly and Jiggle Valve Orientation
Cooling System Service Specifications Table:
Item                        | Specification | Limit
----------------------------+---------------+---------------
Thermostat Opening Valve    | 82 C (180 F)  | 80 - 84 C
Thermostat Full Open Lift   | 8.5 mm or more| Min 8.0 mm
Radiator Cap Relief Pressure| 108 kPa       | 93 - 123 kPa
